values.description: feedback-api URL. Use http://localhost:8080 in dev mode (./mvnw -pl feedback-api quarkus:dev) or the Cloud Function URL in production.
weekly-report Cloud Function URL — output of: gcloud functions describe weekly-report --gen2 --region=southamerica-east1 --format='value(serviceConfig.uri)'
OIDC bearer token for invoking the (private) weekly-report function. Generate with: gcloud auth print-identity-token --audiences=$reportFunctionUrl
